title: Is mathematics about to enter the conservatory?
summary: A reflective essay exploring how AI and LLMs are transforming mathematical research and practice, drawing an analogy to how music became institutionalized through conservatories. The author examines whether mathematics is undergoing a similar paradigm shift as computational tools become integral to proof discovery and mathematical reasoning.
problem_solved: Explores the philosophical and practical implications of AI-assisted mathematics and whether formal institutional changes are needed to accommodate computational mathematical tools.
why_valuable: Provides thought-provoking analysis on how AI is reshaping one of humanity's most rigorous intellectual disciplines, with implications for education, research, and the nature of mathematical truth.
